source_title: Avengers: Doomsday Moves Up India Release Date - IGN India
source_excerpt:
Avengers: Doomsday is heading to theatres in less than two months, and Marvel India has announced an early release for the film in the country. The upcoming fifth Avengers movie will arrive in Indian cinemas a day before its worldwide release. Marvel made the announcement through a special Diwali video featuring Robert Downey Jr. and Chris Evans. Downey Jr., who plays Doctor Doom, and Evans, who returns as Steve Rogers, shared a festive message for Indian fans and confirmed the new release date. Avengers: Doomsday will now release in India on December 17, 2026. View this post on Instagram A post shared by Marvel India (@marvel_india) The video was shared on Marvel India's Instagram account with the caption, “Diwali just got a whole lot more LIT! @robertdowneyjr & @chrisevans have a special festive message for India, along with a dhamakedar tohfa - #AvengersDoomsday now releases a day early in India, on 17th December!” The film will release in India in English, along with dubbed versions in Hindi, Tamil and Telugu. It will be followed by Avengers: Secret Wars , which is scheduled to arrive in theatres on December 17, 2027. Anthony and Joe Russo are returning to direct Avengers: Doomsday. The film will introduce Doctor Doom as the MCU's next major villain and bring together several Marvel teams , including the Avengers, the Fantastic Four and the X-Men. According to the official synopsis , the film follows “beloved heroes from three distinct universes as they’re set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they’ve ever encountered.” Before Avengers: Doomsday arrives in theatres, Marvel has put together a list of 15 movies and TV shows that fans can watch to prepare for the upcoming film. You can also read about a recent tease from directors Joe and Anthony Russo, who revealed that the upcoming Marvel movie will have a “very surprising ending.” Additionally, check out Funko's Avengers: Doomsday Pop! figures , which include several versions of Doctor Doom.
